content:
What do we think is the best way to add inner anodyne morphisms to mathlib? Right now, my plan is to mimic the way @Joël Riou has structured the library for anodyne extensions:

  • add InnerAnodyneExtensions folder and files (Basic, etc.)
  • mimic some of the API in modelCategoryQuillen under the namespace modelCategoryJoyal(?), e.g. in SimplicialSet/CategoryWithFibrations I'm thinking this is a good place for def modelCategoryJoyal.innerFibrations := innerHornInclusions.rlp so that later fibrations can be properly defined here (maybe by @Robin Carlier)

Right now I just want to add enough to be able to formalize the different generating families of inner anodyne moprhisms, so I'd like to add as little API as possible while keeping it extensible.

I believe this could be a file Inner.lean or a subdirectory Inner of SimplicialSet.AnodyneExtensions. (Actually, I would think that the parallel definitions/API for innerAnodyneExtensions could even be in the same file Basic.lean.)
Might that make defining the Joyal model structure more inconvenient in the future? (to put it in the same Basic.lean file)

I do not think that we should set up a CategoryWithFibrations (local) instance for inner fibrations: I do not know much about the Joyal model structure, but the fibrations for this one are the isofibrations.
I would suggest adding an InnerFibration.lean file in the Quasicategory subdirectory, where the generating family modelCategoryJoyal.J (I do not know if J is standard in this case) that is parallel to modelCategoryQuillen.J would be defined, a property of morphisms innerFibrations would also be defined (as J.rlp) and also a typeclass InnerFibration). This is all we need in order to define inner anodyne extensions as innerFibrations.llp.
